# BACILLUS SPECIES

For non-cereus or anthracis isolates, seriously consider as contaminant.

# For B. anthracis isolates, consult Infectious Diseases immediately.

# _______________________________________________________________________________

Therapy:
## B. cereus treatment

Optimal therapy depends on both the disease or syndrome and the pathogen. See disease/syndrome sections for more information. No specific treatment is needed for food poisoning.

Preferred treatment:
[Vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV q12h R](orz-set-abx-vanco-new-start-15mg-kg-q12h-mrsa-nares-screening)
Inpt: ORZID2 GMENU GRAM-POS FI BACILLUS SPP.
